description.value: Island Brew Byou is a long-running (since 1999) brew-on-premise and homebrew supply shop on Station Avenue in Langford, where customers participate in making their own craft beer, wine, fruit wine, and sparkling cider using stainless steel, gas-fired kettles and 200+ product choices. The shop stocks an extensive range of homebrewing equipment and ingredients and is the only Victoria-area location brewing beer this way. It also sells packaged products — including gluten-free beer — to take home.

The website explicitly mentions gluten-free beer options; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-facing amenity anywhere in the fetched content.

This is a brew-on-premise/homebrew supply shop, not a taproom or food-service establishment — an atypical fit for the Food & Drink category in a cycling tourism directory.
